name: Lund University
summary: Founded in 1666, with campuses in Lund, Malmö and Helsingborg; five English bachelor's, all in Lund, are open for 2027.

ib.text: No IB page of its own; the national rules apply. A full IB Diploma gives general entry, and IB English meets English 6. Subjects count at grade 4 (3 at HL Biology, Chemistry, Physics).

dates.label: January round opens (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
January round closes (only if you already hold your IB Diploma)
April round opens (EU/EEA): the round for May 2027 IB candidates
April round: proof of EU/EEA citizenship (fee exemption) due
April round: final IB results due via the IB Result Service (recipient code UHR)
April round: reply to your offer or lose the place

programmes.name: Biomedicine
programmes.ib: Biology and Chemistry (grade 4 at SL, 3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.
programmes.about: Medicine, science and lab skills together, studying diseases such as cancer and diabetes with active researchers, in an environment built around current research.
programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Economy and Society
programmes.ib: Maths at the level of Swedish Maths 3c: AA at grade 3, or AI at 4 (AI HL at 3).
programmes.about: How economies and societies change over time, with the tools to analyse global development and act in a world of constant transformation; alumni work in policy, sustainability and consulting.

needs.note: AI SL at grade 4 also counts.

programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Sciences, Mathematics
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.
programmes.about: Mathematics, mathematical statistics, numerical analysis and computational science, combinable with science, engineering, economics or humanities courses; half the places are for international admission.
programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Sciences, Physics
programmes.ib: Physics and Chemistry (grade 4 at SL, 3 at HL), and Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3.

separateFrom.name: Sciences, Mathematics
separateFrom.reason: One programme (NGNAT) but a different track that you apply to on its own, and it also asks for Physics and Chemistry: what a student must do differs.

programmes.about: Mechanics, electromagnetism, quantum mechanics and thermodynamics with maths and programming, then applied areas from particle to astrophysics, with much lab and project work.
programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

programmes.name: Sciences, Physical Geography and Ecosystem Science
programmes.ib: Maths AA SL at 4, or AA or AI HL at 3, plus two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics.

separateFrom.name: Sciences, Mathematics
separateFrom.reason: One programme (NGNAT) but a different track that you apply to on its own, and it also asks for two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics: what a student must do differs.

separateFrom.name: Sciences, Physics
separateFrom.reason: One programme (NGNAT) but a different track with different sciences: two of Biology, Chemistry and Physics, not Physics and Chemistry.

programmes.about: Soil, water, biosphere and atmosphere and how they interact with people, with GIS, remote sensing, climate modelling, fieldwork and excursions.

needs.note: Any two of the three (3 is enough at HL).

programmes.selectionNote: April round: ranked on your IB converted to Sweden's merit scale (max 22.5); 66% of places on grades, 34% on the SweSAT (in Swedish, optional).

notes: Lund says its international bachelor's programmes open in both rounds, so a May 2027 IB candidate applies in the national round, 15 March to 15 April 2027.
In the national round 66% of places go on school grades and 34% on the Swedish aptitude test, so as an IB student you compete on your converted IB total.
International Business, Development Studies, Fine Arts and the two Malmö music programmes are on Lund's English list of ten, but their pages show no autumn 2027 intake yet.
